detailed_description:
16:9 cinematic frame, physically realistic skin and fabric, intricate embroidery, volumetric light, warm gold contrasted with cool blue runes, dynamic but readable camera movement, convincing weight and cloth motion, stable character identity and coherent anatomy. The black-robed man remains the same person throughout. No reference-sheet white backgrounds, split screens, labels, duplicate characters or watermark. No graphic injury or blood.
[Shot 1, 00:00.000-00:05.000] Begin immediately in motion with a medium-wide low-angle tracking shot across the central temple platform of <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> stands in three-quarter view, both hands holding the closed jade-gold <Subject 3> at chest height. He carefully spreads the two rollers apart to open the glowing scroll. Golden and silver ribbons of spiritual energy rise from it and illuminate his face. His solemn expression changes into restrained joy and recognition. The camera slowly pushes toward his face and the scroll; his long hair and robe hems move in a gentle wind. His mouth remains naturally closed during the male inner narration. A deep composed adult male Mandarin voice, clearly off-screen internal narration, says: <d>[Chinese] 前世困于仙王万年，终于寻得此经。</d>.
[Shot 2, 00:05.000-00:09.000] Hard cut to a medium side view, maintaining <Subject 1>'s identity, dark robes and the same opened scroll. An anonymous adult attacker appears behind him as a dark motion-blurred silhouette and strikes his upper back once with an open palm. Show one readable non-graphic impact, not a prolonged fight. <Subject 1> jolts forward one step, grips the scripture tightly and turns his head in shock. A single controlled camera shake marks the impact. Blue runes flash violently and dust shakes loose from the towering columns. The same male internal narrator says with urgency: <d>[Chinese] 不料遭人暗算，神殿竟在此刻崩塌。</d>. His lips do not articulate the internal narration.
[Shot 3, 00:09.000-00:15.080] Hard cut to a dramatic wide shot from a slightly elevated angle. The temple's upper stone arches and nearby pillars break apart in large readable chunks, floating stones spiral upward and the immense golden-white time vortex above the temple brightens and expands. A powerful upward wind lifts <Subject 1>'s hair and layered robes. Still clutching the jade-gold scripture securely against his chest, he rises off the platform, feet leaving the ground, and is drawn bodily upward into the center of the vortex. The camera pulls back and tilts up to show the scale. Keep his silhouette readable among the spiraling debris; no gore or crushing body injury. The narrator delivers the final line before 00:14.500: <d>[Chinese] 再睁眼，我已重回少年时。</d>. In the final second his figure disappears into the golden light and the frame resolves in a brief luminous transition, suggesting rebirth. Finish decisively without a frozen reference-image hold.
